commits.summary: Check IEEE comparisons and signed-zero witnesses (verification pending)
commits.body:
Carry binary32 and binary64 words through locals, fields and arrays. Compare them with JVM NaN bias, preserve signed zeros in extrema, and qualify raw-bit observations. Load numeric factories and constructors from the selected JDK, preserve mandatory cache identities, and handle reflective array length including its exceptional exits.

The JVM and native checker agreed on all 81 ordered pairs of signed zeros, subnormals, infinities, ordinary numbers and a quiet NaN. The Commons Lang parent produced the independently replayed raw-bit witness [-0.0, +0.0]. All 35 changed test groups passed individually, including the receipt audit run again after isolated investigation probes. Example 313 validation and tier lint passed.

At the original budgets, jobs 20261120-045612-verify-both-signed-zero-maxima-with-ieee, 20261120-045612-recheck-guava-map-collisions-after-nativ and 20261120-045612-recheck-cube-intersections-after-native check the four signed-zero claims and twelve transfer claims.

commits.summary: Prove coverage of bounded IEEE arithmetic (verification pending)
commits.body:
Widen every signed int to binary64 with an exact bit-vector circuit. For other numeric conversions and floating arithmetic, enumerate reachable operand tuples under the path condition, preserving their correlations. Each accepted operation ends with an unsatisfiable complement. A 65th tuple or an unspecified NaN payload leaves a named refusal. The profile includes square root, sign-preserving zero arithmetic, Java narrowing and Guava's highest-bit and rotate operations.

Verified against the JVM on rounding ties at 2^24 and 2^53, signed underflow, saturating casts, NaNs, infinities, the table-size discriminator, and 64 correlated products with the 65th explicitly refused. Changed test groups passed, the initializer fallback was rechecked on the final fixture, and job schema and test-tier lint passed.

Original campaigns continue in 20261120-051056-repeat-signed-zero-proofs-on-the-bounded, 20261120-051056-verify-guava-collision-traces-through-it, 20261120-051056-verify-cube-hits-through-bounded-vector and 20261120-051057-verify-percentage-overflow-after-bounded. All four keep the frozen inputs, classpaths, observers and budgets.

commits.summary: Record all four strict Commons Lang signed-zero verdicts
commits.body:
Import the shared systemd collector's six completed records and their applied receipts byte for byte. Its two Commons Lang runs each established numeric agreement on both revisions and raw-bit agreement on the fix. Both refuted the parent's raw bits. The direct JVM grid shows seven discrepancies in 84 arrays and the native witness reproduces independently.

Each Guava attempt reached Integer.highestOneBit. Each cube attempt reached double subtraction. Those twelve original obligations remained open on the comparison-only checker. The collector's actual executions supersede the local runner's interrupted build copies of the same job IDs, which remain in the preceding history. Validated job schemas, non-vacuity, ordered artifact digests and JVM witness membership for all three packets.
